**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve the Bitget metadata acquisition timestamp**

When collecting Bitget perpetual features, this new metadata-loading path no longer sets `_candidate_markets_acquired_at`, which the removed bootstrap did immediately after `load_markets()`. Consequently `get_funding_observation()` emits `interval_acquired_at=None`; `proved_funding_interval()` rejects that proof, so otherwise valid Bitget perp candidates lose funding-cost economics and produce incomplete experiment outcomes. Stamp the acquisition time when the provider successfully loads perpetual market metadata.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Avoid collapsing dated futures onto perpetual metadata**

When a venue lists both a perpetual swap and a dated USDT future for the same base, `get_market_instruments("perp")` represents both as the same canonical `BASE/USDT` symbol, and this assignment maps both back to one `BASE/USDT:USDT` key. Whichever instrument appears last silently supplies the contract size used for the perpetual ticker, so venues where the dated contract multiplier differs can produce incorrect quote-volume prefilter and persisted feature values. Exclude dated instruments here or preserve the exact physical market identity in the provider fact.
